r15-putaway.title: Putting entries away (archive)
body: You asked why entries can't be archived and when they go away. Today an entry card shows on the Desk for **7 days**, then leaves on its own. Its hours stay on Day, the Timesheet, Items and Find; nothing is ever thrown away. But a card you **moved** stays on the Desk for good, and the only ways to clear it are filing it in a drawer or deleting it, which loses the hours.
Below: a **Put away** that takes a card off the Desk and keeps everything, a **Tidy up** for many at once, and a setting for how long cards stay. Pick any mix.
bullets: **Put away:** in an entry card's right-click menu (and its details). Undo is offered; the details get a Back on the Desk button.
**Tidy up:** one button on the Desk toolbar puts away everything from before today, or older than this week, or the cards you tick.
**How long cards stay:** a setting (1, 3, 7 or 14 days), and whether cards you moved leave too.

questions.legend: How long entries stay on the Desk by themselves

options.value: Let me choose; start at 7 days
Leave after the same time, unless pinned
Stay until I put them away (as now)
